# Poddar Exports (PEXX)

> Hand block printing maker in Jaipur, India. Printing, stitching and finishing happen in our own units. We make bedding, table linen, kids textiles, bags and pouches, and clothing for shops, importers, own-label brands and hotels.

- Every block is carved by hand, and we carve new blocks for a buyer's idea.
- We print a sample, the buyer approves it, and we match the full order to it.
- Colour fastness in washing is something we protect, and some of our buyers have our fabric tested at the best independent labs.
- Prices straight from the maker. We have sent our textiles to Europe, the USA and Australia for many years.
- Owner: Ashwani Poddar. Contact: info@poddarexp.com
- Retail for buyers in India is a separate shop: https://shop.poddarexp.com
